[0] Inactivation of either mxl-1 or mdl-1 did not significantly extend eat-2(ad465) lifespan, with median lifespans of 29.1+/–1.1; 29.3+/–1.1 (p = 0.398); 32.0+/–2.2 days (p = 0.28), respectively.

[1] ad1113 mutation of eat-2 (CHRNA7) increased the lifespan of worms.

[2] No FUdR was used for any of the lifespan assays. Lifespan was count as days from adulthood.

[3] No FUdR was used for any of the lifespan assays. Lifespan was count as days from adulthood.

[4] An over-expression of human clusterin extends the lifespan of Drosophila. rank p-value<0.0001

[5] Authors investigated mice which are homozygous at the COL1A1 gene mutation, {Gln774Pro; Ile776Met; Ala777Pro; Val782Ala; Val783Ala}, this mutation makes collagen resistent to the collagenase which cleaves cjllagen at the site 775-776. Mutant mice hat shortened lifespan. By 70 weeks, all wild type animals were alive, but 65% of mutant mice died. Moreover, mutant mice showed features of premature aging, including kyphosis, weight loss, decreased bone mineral density, and hypertension.

[6] Authors investigated mice which are homozygous at the deletion in the gene COL1A1 first intron. This deletion reduces the COL1A1 gene expression in the heart and aortic tissues.

[7] Authors investigated deletion in the first intron of the COL1A1 gene. This deletion reduces the COL1A1 gene expression in the heart and aortic tissues.

[8] Only about 10% of mutant mice survived to adulthood, and their average lifespan was about 6 months. The main cause of dead was the blood vessel rupture.

[9] A missense mutation in clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans, with maximum effect achieved by keeping the worms at 15°C.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
